## Press Release


## BRAEMAR HOTELS & RESORTS ANNOUNCES CLOSING ON SALE OF FOUR SEASONS RESORT SCOTTSDALE


Company Release - 11/3/2026


DALLAS


, Nov. 3, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) ("Braemar" or the "Company") announced today that it has closed on the previously announced sale of the 210-room Four Seasons Resort Scottsdale for $372 million ($1.8 million per key), subject to customary prorations and adjustments. Including anticipated capital expenditures of $23 million, the sale price represents a 5.8% capitalization rate on net operating income and a 15.0x Hotel EBITDA multiple for the trailing 12 months ended September 2026.


"I am extremely pleased with our investment in the Four Seasons Scottsdale," said Richard J. Stockton, President and Chief Executive Officer. "Having acquired the property in 2022, this transaction further demonstrates our acquisition team's ability to source and underwrite attractive opportunities, in addition to our asset management team's ability to implement deliverable growth strategies. In doing so, we generated an unlevered return of approximately 15%, significantly above our 10% minimum target. We expect the proceeds from this sale, together with cash on hand, to fund the remaining fees owed to our external advisor under our separation agreement. We remain on track to complete our transition to a self-managed REIT in mid-November. We look forward to updating shareholders as we finalize the remaining steps."


**About Braemar Hotels & Resorts**


Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) is a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on the high-growth luxury hotel and resort sector. Its industry-leading portfolio features luxury properties across the United States and the U.S. territories in the Caribbean.
